decisions.text: Not going to work with Ceefax/television page navigation technology
Focus only on television (not video or other platforms)
Target group will be aimed at younger audience (fashion + electronics), though exact demographic not yet defined
Voice recognition not going to be used as a function in the remote
Price limit for production is 12.5 Euros
Remote will be sold separately (not bundled with TV)
Primary emphasis: simplicity and fashion (usability included)
